fullPassage: Instead of asking how much exercise is needed to protect against depression, we should actually be asking how little. The short answer is that just one hour of brisk walking per week has been proven to give some level of protection. If you look into the research, what’s striking is that, in children as well as adults, those who have the most to gain are those who go from doing nothing to doing something — for example, starting to cycle to work or walk to school. But more than that is of course even better, and so one might wonder what level is needed for maximal effects. A number of major, well-conducted studies suggest that between two and six hours of cardiovascular exercise per week is optimal. This is a wide range, but most studies lie closer to two hours than six. More than six hours of exercise per week appears to offer no additional protection.

det.tip: no additional protection = 추가적인 보호가 없다. 수확 체감의 법칙.

ch: 6시간 이상 운동하면 건강에 해로운 영향을 미친다.

운동량이 일정 수준을 넘으면 보호 효과가 더 이상 증가하지 않는다.
보호 효과를 얻으려면 반드시 6시간을 채워야 한다.

questions.passage: Instead of asking how much exercise is needed to protect against depression, we should actually be asking how little. The short answer is that just one hour of brisk walking per week has been proven to give some level of protection. If you look into the research, what’s striking is that, in children as well as adults, <u>those</u> who have the most to gain are those who go from doing nothing to doing something — for example, starting to cycle to work or walk to school. But more than that is of course even better, and so one might wonder what level is needed for maximal effects. A number of major, well-conducted studies suggest that between two and six hours of cardiovascular exercise per week is optimal. This is a wide range, but most studies lie closer to two hours than six. More than six hours of exercise per week appears to offer no additional protection.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>those</u>가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동으로부터 가장 많은 이점을 얻을 수 있는 사람들
det.analysis:
✅ ② 운동으로부터 가장 많은 이점을 얻을 수 있는 사람들: 'those who have the most to gain' = 가장 많이 얻을 사람들.
❌ ① 이미 규칙적으로 운동하고 있는 사람들: 이미 운동하는 사람이 아닌 시작하는 사람.
❌ ③ 우울증 진단을 받은 환자들: 환자 특정 집단이 아닌 일반적 범위.
❌ ④ 심혈관 운동을 연구하는 과학자들: 과학자가 아닌 운동 대상자.
det.tip: those who ~ = ~하는 사람들. have the most to gain = 가장 많이 얻을 것이 있다.

det.korean: 아무것도 안 하다가 무언가를 시작하는 것 (최소한의 운동 시작)
